visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses, wearing a black t-shirt and white earphones, sits in a room with a white gaming chair. He is looking at a screen capturing a mobile game interface on the left side of the frame. He gestures with his hands while speaking excitedly. (2) The man begins to mimic a specific dance movement, pumping his fists rhythmically in front of his chest. He smiles broadly and leans toward the camera. Text overlays with social media handles appear at the bottom. (3) The screen transitions to a split view. The top-left quadrant shows news footage of a politician in a suit and red tie dancing on a stage in front of a crowd and a large helicopter. The right side shows the man in the room laughing uncontrollably while perfectly synchronizing his fist-pumping dance with the footage. (4) Multiple cuts show different rally scenes of the same politician dancing to music. The man continues his mimicry, laughing so hard he occasionally leans out of the frame or covers his face with his hands. (5) The video ends with the man waving his hand and laughing while the background shows the politician continuing to clap and dance for his supporters.
